candidates.angle: The word tamasam, tamasic, marks the lowest form of charity
Krishna names the conditions of a gift, giving four reasons for its low quality
candidates.evidence: अदेशकाले (at an improper place and time), अपात्रेभ्यः (to unworthy recipients), असत्कृतम् (without respect), अवज्ञातम् (with contempt)

candidates.angle: a gift is judged by the giver's contempt and the recipient's unworthiness
candidates.evidence: अपात्रेभ्यः (to unworthy recipients) and असत्कृतम् (without respect) and अवज्ञातम् (with contempt)

angle_en: Tamasam: the four marks of the lowest charity
angle_hi: तामसम्: सबसे नीच दान के चार चिह्न

en.intro: Krishna has just described a giving that is mixed with self-interest, and now he names the lowest form. Listen to the four ways a gift can fail.
en.notice: The word tamasam, tamasic, appears at the end, and it is attached to four conditions: the wrong place, the wrong time, the wrong person, and contempt.
en.next: The next verse moves from the act of giving to the three syllables that name the supreme reality.
en.meaning: Charity given at the wrong place and time, to an unworthy recipient, without respect and with contempt, is called tamasic.

hi.meaning: जो दान बिना सत्कारके तथा अवज्ञापूर्वक अयोग्य देश और काल में कुपात्र को दिया जाता है, वह दान तामस कहा गया है।
hi.notice: शब्द है तामसम्, यानी तामसिक, जो अंत में आता है और इसके साथ चार बातें जुड़ी हैं: गलत जगह, गलत समय, गलत व्यक्ति और तिरस्कार।
hi.next: अगला श्लोक दान के कर्म से हटकर उस परम सत्य के तीन नामों की ओर बढ़ता है।
